description: This source file defines core functionalities for a web server plugin, including WSGI support, HTML caching, user authentication, and xsendfile handling in Lua.

methods.name: wsgi
methods.description: Sets up WSGI application routing based on a URI prefix with associated backend actions.

methods.name: cached_html
methods.description: Returns an action that serves cached or dynamically generated HTML files based on file existence.

methods.name: auth_require_user
methods.description: Enforces user authentication by matching the REMOTE_USER against a provided user list.

methods.name: xsendfile
methods.description: Creates a handler to serve files from a specified document root efficiently.
